findings: Changing the checkout idempotency-key format invalidates keys created before deployment. Retries of an existing order attempt after rollout will use a different key and may bypass prior idempotency protection, risking duplicate checkout/payment creation.
evidence: `idempotencyKey` changes from `${orderId}:${attemptNumber}` to `${orderId}|${attemptNumber}` with no compatibility lookup or migration shown.
checked: Idempotency-key continuity across the proposed format change.
gaps: No evidence of a rollout strategy, dual-read compatibility, or confirmation that existing idempotency records are not relied on across deployments.
